name: tracker-brief-sync
description: Turn a brief or PRD (such as prd-draft output) into tracker-ready epics and issues — title, description, acceptance criteria, labels and a link back to the doc section — as a CSV for Jira, a mapped CSV for other importers, or gh commands for GitHub; and in reverse, report drift between the doc and the tracker (issues with no section, sections with no issue, issues for Won't-have requirements). Use when the user wants to load a PRD into Jira, Linear or GitHub, says "create tickets from this brief", or asks "does the tracker still match the PRD?".

handoff.when: a requirement is too large for one story
handoff.purpose: Slice it into independently shippable stories before it goes into the spec.
handoff.fallback: If user-story-splitter is absent, create one story for the requirement and list it under 'needs splitting' in the hand-over.

permissions.notes: The github target writes a shell script of gh commands for the user to run; it runs nothing itself.

model.rationale: Maps doc sections to items and writes acceptance criteria that restate requirements; a script checks the spec, writes the import file and computes drift. Bounded transformation with a deterministic check.
